description: This source file provides a thin API layer for interacting with catalog endpoints related to skills and lessons. It contains functions for fetching skills, fetching a skill by slug, fetching lessons by skill slug, and fetching a specific lesson by ID. The functions handle API request/response cycles, including fallbacks for legacy endpoints. It uses fetch API calls to communicate with backend endpoints specified by a base URL from configuration.

methods.name: handleResponse(res)
methods.description: Handles the fetch response by parsing JSON or text, checking for errors, and returning structured data.

methods.name: toPageParams(limit = 12, offset = 0)
methods.description: Generates pagination parameters (page and page_size) based on limit and offset.

methods.name: fetchSkills({ category, limit = 12, offset = 0 } = {})
methods.description: Retrieves a paginated list of skills, optionally filtered by category, with fallback to legacy endpoint.

methods.name: fetchSkillBySlug(slug)
methods.description: Fetches a single skill by its slug, with fallbacks to ID and list search if needed.

methods.name: fetchLessonsBySkillSlug(slug)
methods.description: Retrieves lessons associated with a given skill slug.

methods.name: fetchLessonById(id, { skillSlug } = {})
methods.description: Retrieves a lesson by ID, with fallback to searching within lessons of a specific skill.

ctags.pattern: /^export async function fetchSkills({ category, limit = 12, offset = 0 } = {}) {$/
